description: Anonymized scanner/offensive request corpus. Each scenario is a sequence of requests and an expected outcome. Never point this at external systems.

scenarios.name: 100 normal page requests
scenarios.note: Legitimate traffic must never be banned or challenged.

scenarios.name: .env probe
scenarios.note: Sensitive file probing must be blocked immediately.

scenarios.name: encoded .git/config probe
scenarios.note: Encoded variants of critical paths must be detected.

scenarios.name: double encoded traversal
scenarios.note: Double encoded traversal to /etc/passwd must be detected at decode depth 2.

scenarios.name: RCE probe via query string
scenarios.note: php://input in the query string is a critical RCE probe.

scenarios.name: aws credentials probing
scenarios.note: Credential probing for AWS must block.

scenarios.name: burst of unique random 404s
scenarios.note: 30 unique random paths within the window must raise the behavior score into the challenge band.

scenarios.name: fake Chrome UA with scanner pattern
scenarios.note: A spoofed browser UA must not protect a scanner pattern.
